pattern: 甲斐もなく（かいもなく）
purpose: Say that effort failed to produce its hoped-for result.
keywords: give explain a reason cause result
Vた + 甲斐もなく; N + の甲斐もなく
Despite working all night, my manuscript was rejected.
Despite searching everywhere, I did not find the key.
formation: Vた + 甲斐もなく; N + の甲斐もなく
restrictions: The preceding effort is real but unsuccessful.
mistake: Do not use it for success; that takes 甲斐があって.
